A short quest near Thais. Enter a cave west of the Ancient Temple entrance, follow it to a room with a well, go down the well and open the chests guarded by scorpions to receive a {item:Scale Armor}.
Hole west of the Ancient Temple entrance (Thais)
or {item:Antidote} / {item:Silver Amulet}, recommended against the Scorpions' poison
{creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} poison you: bring an {item:Antidote}, an {item:Antidote Rune} or a {item:Silver Amulet}.

Start from the temple or the depot of **Thais** and leave the city through the **north** gate. The {wiki:Ancient Temple} is just **north-west** of the north gate, north of Thais ({coord:32356,32170,7}). Go to the entrance of the Ancient Temple.
Go to the cave **immediately west** of the entrance to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, near Thais. Use the {item:Shovel} to open the hole and go down.
Follow the path **north** and then **east** until you find a room with a well. On the way you may meet {creature:Rat|Rats}, {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats} and {creature:Troll|Trolls}.
Path from the entrance to the well room
2. Going down the well and opening the chests
"Use" the **bottom-right corner** (south-east) of the well to go down it.
Down there are one or more {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}. Have your poison cure ready.
Kill the scorpions and open the chests to receive the {item:Scale Armor}.

To leave, go back the **same way**: return to the well room and follow the map route in reverse (**west** and then **south**) to the entrance hole. The {item:Rope} (mandatory quest equipment) is for climbing up through the holes to the surface, next to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}. From there head **south** to the north gate of Thais.
